31924-XI.s: This bill sets the final budget adjustments (slotwetmutaties) for the Ministry of Housing, Spatial Planning and the Environment for 2008, including changes to commitments, expenditure and revenue per policy article, and for the Nederlandse Emissieautoriteit and Waddenfonds. It also allows the ministry's 2008 annual report to omit certain Comptabiliteitswet 2001 presentation requirements, instead linking information to ministerial priorities.
q: Notwithstanding Article 54(3) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, the information referred to in that paragraph is not included per policy article in the 2008 annual report of the Ministry of Housing, Spatial Planning and the Environment.

In afwijking van artikel 54, derde lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 wordt in het jaarverslag van het ministerie van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer (XI) voor het jaar 2008 de informatie, bedoeld in dat artikellid, niet per beleidsartikel opgenomen.
p: Derogates from Comptabiliteitswet 2001 by limiting per-policy-article reporting in the 2008 annual report and linking information to ministerial priorities chosen by the minister.

32500-XII.s: The bill formally establishes the 2011 departmental budget statement (Begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Transport and Water Management (XII), setting appropriations in thousands of euros. It also adopts the 2011 budget statements for the agency-run services Royal Netherlands Meteorological Institute, Rijkswaterstaat and the Inspectorate of Transport and Water Management, with the law taking effect on 1 January 2011.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Transport and Water Management (XII) for the year 2011 belonging to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Verkeer en Waterstaat (XII) voor het jaar 2011 wordt vastgesteld.

32565-IV.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget of the Kingdom Relations ministry (chapter IV) by a second supplementary budget, adjusting appropriations for the guarantee function and for autonomy support to Kingdom partners. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 December 2010.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of Kingdom Relations (IV) for 2010 (amendment linked to the Autumn Memorandum)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) voor het jaar 2010 (wijziging samenhangend met de Najaarsnota)

32565-VI.s: This bill amends the 2010 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Security and Justice (VI) via a supplementary budget (Najaarsnota), adjusting commitments, expenditure and revenue across policy articles. It also sets the effective date of the amended budget statement and orders its publication in the Staatsblad.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of the Ministry of Security and Justice (VI) for 2010 (amendment linked to the autumn budget memorandum)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie (VI) voor het jaar 2010 (wijziging samenhangende met de Najaarsnota)

33000-XV.s: The bill sets the 2012 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (SZW) and the 2012 budget statements for its baten-lasten agencies (Agentschap SZW and Inspectie Werk en Inkomen), in thousands of euros, effective 1 January 2012. The bill itself delegates no rule-making power; the attached memorandum describes policy, agency budgets and spending plans for 2012.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2012 accompanying this law is hereby adopted.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2012 wordt vastgesteld.

33240-VII.s: This bill (slotwet) amends the 2011 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the budget statement for its business-operations services, converting the appropriation figures from the first and second supplementary budgets into realized outcomes. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year. The bill itself contains no delegation of rule-making power, and no explanatory memorandum text is included.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2011 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.

De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2011 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33400-XII.s: The bill sets the 2013 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment (XII) and the 2013 budget statements of its agencies, in thousands of euros. It is a budget law with no new delegations or power shifts; the explanatory memorandum describes spending programmes, policy goals and oversight by the Inspectorate.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment for the year 2013 attached to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu voor het jaar 2013 wordt vastgesteld.

33480-IXA.s: This bill amends the 2012 budget statement for the National Debt (IXA) by adjusting expenditure and revenue figures in line with the Autumn Memorandum, effective from 1 December 2012. It concerns the financing of state debt, debt redemption and issuance, and the treatment of interest costs.
q: We Beatrix, by the grace of God, Queen of the Netherlands, Princess of Orange-Nassau, etc. etc. etc.
Wij Beatrix, bij de gratie Gods, Koningin der Nederlanden, Prinses van Oranje-Nassau, enz. enz. enz.

33605-IXB.s: This bill sets the final adjustment (slotwet) to the 2012 budget of the Ministry of Finance (IXB), changing the departmental budget statement and the baten-lastendiensten statements for Domeinen Roerende Zaken and the Rijksvastgoed- en Ontwikkelingsbedrijf. It enacts the realised budget figures and fixes the amounts in thousands of euros, with effect from the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for the year 2012, established by the act of 26 January 2012
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2012, vastgesteld bij de wet van 26 januari 2012

33805-IX.s: This bill amends the 2013 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt budget (IXA) in line with the autumn budget revision, changing appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros with effect from 1 December 2013. It contains no delegation of rule-making power to the executive and no changes to oversight or judicial review.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for the year 2013 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2013 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33940-IX.s: This bill amends the 2014 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt budget (IXA) in the first supplementary budget, adjusting appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros. It takes effect on 1 June of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for 2014 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2014 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34210-XII.s: This bill amends the 2015 budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment and its agencies, shifting appropriations across policy articles, including a large reduction in the investment fund contribution. It is a supplementary budget with no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: Thus it is that We, in common consultation with the States General, have resolved and enacted, as We hereby resolve and enact
Zo is het, dat Wij, met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan, gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze

34300-XII.s: This bill sets the 2016 budget (begrotingsstaten) for the Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment and its agencies, in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum describes spending priorities and policy programmes across infrastructure, environment, climate, safety and the inspectorate ILT, and does not itself create new delegated rule-making powers.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment for the year 2016, attached to this law, is established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu voor het jaar 2016 wordt vastgesteld.

34725-IV.s: This bill amends the 2016 budget statements for the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations (Koninkrijksrelaties, section IV) and the BES-fonds (section H) through a closing budget law (Slotwet). It sets out the revised appropriations, realisations and closing adjustments in thousands of euros, effective from the day after publication in the Staatsblad.

34725-VI.s: This bill amends the 2016 departmental budget statement and the agency budget statements of the Ministry of Security and Justice, as a Slotwet (final budget adjustment) to reflect actual spending. It sets the budget figures in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Security and Justice (VI) for the year 2016 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie (VI) voor het jaar 2016 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34950-IV.s: This bill amends the 2017 budget statements for Kingdom Relations (IV) and the BES Fund (H) through a final budget adjustment act (Slotwet), mainly to record actual spending and revenue against the original and supplementary budgets. It sets the budgets in thousands of euros and provides that the act takes effect the day after publication and applies retroactively to 31 December 2017.
q: Amendment of the 2017 budget statement for Kingdom Relations (IV) (final budget adjustment act).
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) voor het jaar 2017 (Slotwet).

34950-VI.s: This slotwet amends the 2017 departmental budget statement and the agency budget statements of the Ministry of Security and Justice, adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across policy and non-policy articles. It also sets the budget figures in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force the day after publication, with retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
q: We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Security and Justice
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie

34989.s: The bill amends the Dutch Studiefinanciering 2000 Act so that students studying abroad qualify for portable student finance either through a link with the Netherlands (criteria to be set in an AMvB, including for EU free-movement workers) or through the existing three-out-of-six-years residence test, and adds a transitional clause protecting current recipients. It also extends the voucher rules to EU programmes, allows delegated regulation of personal data processing, and removes an obsolete transitional provision.
34989.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by stating that the link criteria are regulated by AMvB because the Court of Justice ruling requires a concrete link test, and that personal data rules were delegated after the Council of State advised the basis was too thin.
q: In this bill it is provided that the student must demonstrate a link with the Netherlands before being able to claim portable student finance.
In dit wetsvoorstel wordt geregeld dat de student moet aantonen dat hij een band met Nederland heeft alvorens aanspraak te kunnen maken op meeneembare studiefinanciering.
d: criteria for a link with the Netherlands for EU-worker students
criteria a foreign higher education programme must meet
manner in which personal data for the voucher may be processed
p: Eligibility for EU-worker students depends on link criteria set by general administrative order rather than in the statute itself.
Processing of personal data for the voucher is left to delegated rules, with the explanatory memorandum stating the student may choose how to demonstrate the link.

parties: Asks what the effects of the amendment will be, how many previously rejected students would now qualify, who will assess the soft criteria, and what the implementation costs and regulatory burden are.
Who will assess the soft criteria used to determine whether a student has sufficient ties to the Netherlands, and what are the expected implementation costs and regulatory burden, ask these members.

Wie gaat de zachte criteria beoordelen aan de hand waarvan bepaald kan worden of een student voldoende band heeft met Nederland en wat zijn hiervan de verwachte uitvoeringskosten en gevolgen voor de regeldruk, zo vragen de voornoemde leden.
Broadly endorses the minister's letter and asks for clarification on the students covered by EU-law equal treatment with workers.
They wholeheartedly endorse the main lines of this letter and have a few further questions.
Zij onderschrijven van harte de hoofdlijnen van deze brief en hebben nog een enkele vraag.

Questions why the criteria are set by AMvB rather than in statute, asks whether a voorhang procedure will be considered, and questions whether language criteria produce consequences for Dutch-speaking border populations.
The members wonder why an AMvB was chosen and whether the government is considering a voorhang procedure.
De leden vragen zich af waarom er gekozen is voor een AMvB en of de regering een voorhangprocedure overweegt.

35200-XII.s: This bill (Slotwet) amends the 2018 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Waterstaat and the budget statements of its agencies RWS, ILT and KNMI, setting final figures for appropriations, expenditure, receipts and revenue. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Waterstaat
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

35470-IX.s: This bill amends the 2019 budget statements (slotwet) of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA) to reflect realised amounts. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have approved and resolved ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for the year 2019 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2019 wordt gewijzigd

35650-IX.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2020 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA), mainly to adjust commitments, expenditure and receipts across policy articles. The explanatory memorandum explains the changes in terms of budget rules, COVID-19 effects, and timing shifts, with no new delegation or shift of powers.
35650-IX.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by reference to the Rijksbegrotingsvoorschriften, improved commitment management and the COVID-19 crisis rather than by any new powers.
q: In accordance with the Government Budget Regulations (RBV), the changes per article that are equal to or larger than the lower limits in the table below are explained.
Conform de Rijksbegrotingsvoorschriften (RBV) worden per artikel de mutaties die groter of gelijk zijn aan de ondergrenzen in de onderstaande staffel (tabel 1) toegelicht.

35799.s: The bill amends the 2021 budget of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) through a second supplementary budget, reducing spending by 36,215 thousand euros on the Toeslagen article to write off public debts of people wronged by the childcare benefits affair. It sets an effective date of 12 April 2021 and contains no delegation of rule-making power.
q: Amendment of the 2021 budget of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) (Second supplementary budget on writing off public debts of childcare benefits victims)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2021 (Tweede incidentele suppletoire begroting inzake Kwijtschelding publieke schulden Toeslagengedupeerden)

35830-IX.s: This bill amends the 2020 budget statements (Slotwet) for the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA), recording the actual realised amounts against the budgeted and supplementary figures. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides that the law enters into force the day after publication and takes effect retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
35830-IX.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to overruns in commitment room, audit findings at the Tax Administration and lower AFM revenues due to the coronavirus crisis, without any delegation of power.
q: Due to the coronavirus crisis, AFM revenues are lower than previously budgeted and levies imposed on supervised institutions are received later.
Door de coronacrisis zijn de ontvangsten van de AFM lager dan eerder begroot en komen aan onder toezichtstaande instellingen opgelegde heffingen later binnen.

35850-IV.s: This first supplementary budget for 2021 amends the Kingdom Relations budget (IV) and the BES-fonds budget (H), raising Kingdom Relations spending by 6,975 thousand euros overall. It reallocates funds within the rule-of-law article, moving money to Defence for border control and to the judiciary, and takes effect the day after publication, retroactive to 1 June 2021.
q: Amendment of the Kingdom Relations budget and the BES-fonds budget, both for the year 2021
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties en van het BES-fonds, beide voor het jaar 2021

35850-VI.s: This is the first supplementary budget bill (eerste suppletoire begroting) for 2021 of the Ministry of Justice and Security, adjusting the departmental budget and the budgets of its agencies in thousands of euros. It makes no changes to statutory powers, delegations, or oversight arrangements.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget of the Ministry of Justice and Security
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid

35889.s: This omnibus bill (Verzamelwet EZK) makes mostly technical corrections across several economic and climate-related statutes, including changes to the Waarborgwet 2019 on precious metal labelling, data-sharing powers between health regulators and the ACM, the Handelsregisterwet, and statistics legislation. It also clarifies which appeal court hears certain decisions and updates cross-references and ministerial names.
35889.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as necessary technical corrections of errors, outdated references and gaps, with minor effects on regulatory burden.
q: Having found it advisable to make technical or otherwise minor amendments to several laws due to identified misprints, incorrect references, defects and gaps.
hebben goedgevonden en verstaan, gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze: ARTIKEL I (AANBESTEDINGSWET 2012)
d: guarantee requirements for plated precious metal layers
ARTIKEL IV (Handelsregisterwet 2007, art. 9 f en 12 e)
designation of Legal Entity Identifier standard
ARTIKEL XVII (Wet op het CBS, art. 38c lid 1 en 2)
reporting method and simplification methods for business statistics

parties: Asks on what problem analysis the changes are deemed necessary, given that the scope of the future problem is not clearly established.
On the basis of which problem analysis are the proposed changes considered necessary?
Op basis van welke probleemanalyse worden de voorliggende wijzigingen als noodzakelijk geacht?
Has no remarks or questions on the bill.
They have found no reason to make remarks or ask questions.
Zij hebben geen aanleiding gevonden tot het maken van opmerkingen en het stellen van vragen.
Supports the bill's aim and notes that Raad van State advice has been incorporated; no further explanation needed at this stage.
The members endorse the aim of this bill and at this stage have no need for further explanation.
De leden onderschrijven het doel van dit wetsvoorstel en hebben in deze fase van de behandeling geen behoefte aan een nadere toelichting.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill introducing legal bases for processing medical personal data in the ACM Act and the Wet marktordening gezondheidszorg, asking for justification of restricting the GDPR objection right and of the specific tasks requiring the data. The minister's reply supplemented the explanatory memorandum with the necessity and proportionality arguments and specified the competition-law purposes, accepting the editorial remarks.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for explanation of the necessity and proportionality of disapplying the GDPR Article 21 objection right for medical data processed by the ACM, which the minister supplied in the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling asked that the specific tasks and purposes under the Mededingingswet chapters requiring the medical data disclosure be specified, and the minister added these in the explanatory memorandum.
Editorial remarks were incorporated into the bill and explanatory memorandum, and a blank line was added to Article 45 of the Waarborgwet for readability.

35898.s: The bill extends the Temporary Experiments Act on ballot papers and central vote counting by two years, from 1 January 2022 to 1 January 2024, and adds an evaluation duty for each experiment. It also provides that the Act lapses early once the related Kieswet amendments enter into force and removes provisions that those amendments would make redundant.
35898.j: The memorandum justifies the two-year extension by the risk that the related Kieswet bills are delayed, so that a further extension would otherwise be needed.
q: Therefore it is proposed to extend the duration of the Experiments Act to 1 January 2024.
Daarom wordt voorgesteld de werkingsduur van de Experimentenwet te verlengen tot 1 januari 2024.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel A (artikel 5, eerste lid)
reporting on effectiveness and effects of each experiment

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no remarks on the bill amending the Tijdelijke experimentenwet stembiljetten en centrale stemopneming to extend its duration, and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The government's reply (nader rapport) is brief, simply acknowledging the advice and forwarding the bill.

35979.s: The bill approves the royal decree that extended the validity of provisions of the Temporary COVID-19 Measures Act for a fourth time, under the procedure in article VIII of that Act. It also sets out the citation and entry into force of the approval law.
35979.j: The memorandum justifies the fourth extension by pointing to the government's consultation of the OMT, socio-economic reflection, and parliamentary involvement under the procedural rules of the Wpg, and notes that advice from the Raad van State was waived under article VIII, fourth paragraph.
q: Through the procedural rules laid down in article 58c of the Wpg, parliamentary involvement in decision-making on the measures is secured.
Via de in artikel 58c, Wpg, neergelegde procedureregels is bij besluitvorming over de maatregelen de parlementaire betrokkenheid geborgd.
d: VIII, derde lid (Tijdelijke wet maatregelen covid-19, approved via Article 1)
extension of validity of temporary COVID-19 measure provisions by royal decree
p: The approval law confirms a royal decree extending COVID-19 measure provisions, giving parliament a formal approval role over the executive's extension.

parties: Supports the extension but insists measures must not last longer than necessary, asks for clarity on the long term and on the reasons for retaining or dropping specific powers.
These members consider it important that measures do not remain in place longer than necessary, and this also applies to the present act.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vinden het belangrijk dat maatregelen niet langer dan noodzakelijk blijven en dat geldt ook voor de onderhavige wet.
Considers the act still necessary but questions why the alcohol provision is kept against OMT and Raad van State advice and asks for an overview of unused articles.
Why does the government nonetheless consider it necessary to maintain this article, which concerns alcohol sales?
Waarom acht de regering het dan tóch noodzakelijk om dit artikel, dat betrekking heeft op alcoholverkoop, in stand te houden?
Supports a revision of the Public Health Act, as called for in an adopted motion, and asks about its implementation and timing.
When does the government expect to be able to submit a bill for this revision to the House?
Wanneer verwacht de regering dat zij een wetsvoorstel voor deze herziening aan de Kamer kan voorleggen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advises on extending the temporary COVID-19 measures (Twm) by three months to 1 March 2022, finding extension broadly justified but urging attention to effectiveness, consistency and predictability of phased relaxation, and asking for fuller explanation of planned additional measures. The government's reply accepts the need to weigh tempo and predictability, updates the explanatory note with the new scenario approach and the status of the cluster closure bill, and keeps the alcohol-sales grondslag that was initially to lapse, following consultation with the Bonaire island council.
concerns: The Afdeling asks attention to the effectiveness of the Twm, warning that abrupt relaxation followed by tightening undermines credibility and compliance, and asks for a more consistent, explainable application of the framework.
The Afdeling notes that rapid phasing-out may paradoxically prolong restrictions and asks the explanatory note to address the tempo of phasing in and out.
The explanatory note should address the planned additional statutory grounds and their timetable, which the government has updated.
The grondslag for alcohol restrictions in public places, initially not extended, is retained on the basis of the Bonaire island council's advice.

35988.s: The bill amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport through a 14th incidental supplementary budget for COVID-19 measures, with effect from 10 December 2021. The explanatory memorandum also records a state guarantee of up to EUR 188.3 million for laboratory analysis capacity, expected to be needed until 31 March 2022.
35988.j: The memorandum justifies the guarantee by the need to ensure sufficient laboratory analysis capacity to control the spread of the virus and protect people from infection.
q: It is of great importance that sufficient testing can take place to control the spread of the virus and to protect people in the Netherlands from infection.
Het is van groot belang dat er voldoende getest kan worden om verspreiding van het virus te controleren en om mensen in Nederland te beschermen tegen besmetting.

35997.s: The bill amends the 2021 Ministry of Defence budget statement through a supplementary budget, raising commitment authority by 25,000 thousand euro, mainly for the Inzet and Landmacht articles and the central department. It sets the budget in thousands of euro and makes the change effective from 21 December 2021, with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen for an amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2021
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2021

36100-XII.s: This bill is a supplementary budget law (Slotwet) that amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Waterstaat and the budgets of its agencies RWS, ILT and KNMI to reflect actual realisation. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, no new executive powers and no changes to checks on the executive.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Waterstaat for the year 2021 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36120-VII.s: This first supplementary budget (eerste suppletoire begroting) amends the 2022 budget of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations, adjusting spending and revenue across policy articles such as housing, energy transition, Groningen and public administration. The explanatory memorandum mainly reports budget reallocations, such as funds for housing bottlenecks, the Warmtefonds, the Kiesraad and energy poverty measures distributed to municipalities.
q: On the policy content and the invocation of article 2.27, second paragraph, of the Comptabiliteitswet 2016, the States General were previously informed via the letter to parliament.
Over de beleidsmatige inhoud en het beroep op artikel 2.27, tweede lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2016 zijn de Staten-Generaal eerder geïnformeerd via de Kamerbrief

36435-IV.s: The bill amends the 2023 budget statements for Kingdom Relations (IV) and the BES Fund (H), adjusting appropriations and receipts as a supplementary Prinsjesdag budget. It has retroactive effect to 19 September 2023 and is a purely fiscal adjustment without new delegations of rule-making power.
q: This concerns a cash shift of LPO funds to 2024 to cover the higher costs of the collective labour agreement.
Dit betreft een kasschuif van LPO-middelen naar 2024 om de hogere kosten voor de CAO te kunnen dekken.

36435-VI.s: This bill amends the 2023 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security, adjusting appropriations and receipts across policy articles (police, judiciary, security, detention, counterterrorism, migration) via a supplementary budget. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and takes effect the day after publication, retroactive to 19 September 2023.
36435-VI.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the budget changes by extra funds for organised crime, the Royal and Diplomatic Security Service, personal escort tasks and camera surveillance, not by any new executive power.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security for the year 2023
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid voor het jaar 2023

36550-IX.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2024 budget statements of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA), revising appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros with effect from 1 June 2024. It makes no delegation of rule-making power, shifts no power to the executive, and its explanatory extract covers budget changes such as the Toeslagen restoration operation and lower interest costs.
36550-IX.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to higher Toeslagen restoration costs and lower interest expenditure, not by any delegation or new powers.
q: Following the revision of the Toeslagen Herstel figures based on growth in applications and affected persons, the compensation and restoration expenditure and the administrative costs of carrying out the restoration operation are expected to be higher than previously budgeted.

Naar aanleiding van de bijstelling van de cijfers van Toeslagen Herstel op basis van de groei van aanmeldingen en gedupeerden vallen de compensatie- en hersteluitgaven en de apparaatsuitgaven om de hersteloperatie uit te voeren naar verwachting hoger uit dan eerder begroot.

36613-IX.s: This bill amends the 2024 budget statutes of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA) through a third supplementary budget, adjusting spending, revenue and commitment figures by article. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and gives the amendments retroactive effect to 17 September 2024.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for the year 2024 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2024 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36699.s: The bill amends the primary, special and secondary education acts to replace existing curriculum provisions with a statutory basis for core objectives (kerndoelen) focused on reading, writing and arithmetic, plus new core objectives on citizenship and digital literacy. It removes the parliamentary post-approval (nahang) requirement for core objectives set by general administrative order (amvb).
36699.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by noting that the government prefers not to involve parliament in delegated regulation unless special reasons exist, and that core objectives are set in consultation with the education field.
q: In line with the government's policy of not providing for formal parliamentary involvement in delegated regulation unless there are special reasons, it was therefore decided not to include a nahang provision.

In lijn met het beleid van de regering om geen formele betrokkenheid te regelen van het parlement bij gedelegeerde regelgeving – tenzij daarvoor bijzondere redenen bestaan – is daarom ervoor gekozen om niet te voorzien in een nahangbepaling.
d: I-B-3 (Art. 9 lid 2, Wet op het primair onderwijs)
II-B (Art. 11 lid 2, Wet primair onderwijs BES)
core objectives for Caribbean Netherlands primary education
III-B-3 (Art. 13 lid 2, Wet op de expertisecentra)
core objectives for first two years of secondary education
core objectives for third year of havo and vwo
I-B-9 (Art. 9 lid 8, Wet op het primair onderwijs)
Friese taal core objectives set by provinciale staten of Fryslân by verordening

parties: Questions the government's urgency and whether core-goal reform should proceed as gradual, teacher-involved change rather than top-down reform.
Warns that detailed core goals set by AMvB could restrict school and teacher autonomy and asks how over-detailing is prevented.
These members stress the importance of clear core goals that give direction to education, but warn against excessive detail that could limit the pedagogical autonomy of schools and teachers.

Deze leden benadrukken het belang van duidelijke kerndoelen die richting geven aan het onderwijs, maar waarschuwen voor overmatige detaillering die de pedagogische autonomie van scholen en leraren kan beperken.
Opposes removing the nahang procedure, arguing parliament should retain some input on how the government implements the reduction of core goals.
Removing the nahang provision would entirely eliminate that parliamentary input.
Het schrappen van de nahangbepaling zou die inspraak volledig wegnemen.
Asks about risks of narrowing education toward basic skills and about implementation support for teachers.
Does the government see the risk of education being impoverished by the one-sided focus on these basic skills, rather than building knowledge?
Ziet de regering het risico van onderwijsverschraling door de eenzijdige focus op deze basisvaardigheden, in plaats van de opbouw van kennis?

Asks for a pre-adoption consultation (voorhang) instead of removing the nahang, so parliament can assess the detailed AMvB; also questions the exclusive emphasis on basic skills and the cultural arts specifications.
The fact that insight into the system of core goals only becomes visible in the AMvB justifies including a pre-adoption procedure.
Het feit dat het zicht op de systematiek van de kerndoelen pas zichtbaar is in de AMvB rechtvaardigt het opnemen van een voorhang.

Worries that AMvB elaboration may restrict school freedom of organisation and asks why a voorhang was not chosen over removing the nahang; also raises inspectorate discretion on factors outside school control.
Does this risk not justify formal parliamentary involvement after all?
Rechtvaardigt dit risico niet alsnog formele betrokkenheid van het parlement?
Asks the government to reflect on broader causes of weak language and arithmetic outcomes beyond secondary schooling, such as early childhood education and teacher quality.
Can the government reflect on this at length?
Kan de regering hier uitgebreid op reflecteren?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill revising the statutory basis of core curriculum goals (kerndoelen) for primary and secondary education, focusing on reading, writing and arithmetic, digital literacy and citizenship, asking for clarity on the delegation to general administrative orders and reconsideration of the post-adoption (nahang) parliamentary procedure. The government's reply accepts most points: it clarifies the reading/writing/arithmetic obligation and the integrated approach, adds limits on citizenship goals to respect school freedom, and drops the nahang procedure in favour of no formal parliamentary involvement.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for clarity on the scope of delegated kerndoelen and their elaboration by AMvB and whether the 'uitwerking' extends the delegated power; the government clarified the scope and limited citizenship goals to the statutory citizenship mandate.

The Afdeling argued the chosen nahang procedure does not fit the purpose of delegation and asked for reconsideration of parliamentary involvement; the government dropped the nahang provision in favour of restraint in formal parliamentary involvement.

The Afdeling asked how the focus on reading, writing and arithmetic fits an integrated improvement approach and the revised curriculum; the government explained the broader Herstelplan and Masterplan measures and added explanatory text, but did not fully detail the mechanism.

The Afdeling raised the risk that detailed goals, especially on citizenship, could infringe the constitutional freedom of school direction and pedagogical autonomy under Article 23 of the Constitution; the government stated that the citizenship goals are bounded by the statutory mandate and the explanatory memorandum was supplemented.
Technical and drafting adjustments were made, including harmonising provisions and renumbering subsections, with a provision on overlap with the Wet referentieniveaus Nederlandse taal en rekenen.

36820-IX.s: This bill amends the 2025 budget statements of the Ministry of Finance and the National Debt, adding supplementary budget amounts for September 2025 and clarifying the tax revenue and budget mutations. It is essentially a budgetary adjustment law with no new delegations of rule-making power or changes to oversight.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IX) for the year 2025
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IX) voor het jaar 2025

36879.s: The bill amends the Omgevingswet and the Algemene wet bestuursrecht to replace references to the repealed air quality directives with references to Directive (EU) 2024/2881 on ambient air quality. It also adds territorial units for average exposure and makes technical renumbering changes.
36879.j: The memorandum justifies the implementation at the level of a general administrative order and ministerial regulation as the appropriate level for the directive's detailed rules.
q: Implementation of the directive is foreseen at the level of a general administrative order in the Besluit kwaliteit leefomgeving and the Omgevingsregeling.
Implementatie van de richtlijn is voorzien op het niveau van een algemene maatregel van bestuur in het Besluit kwaliteit leefomgeving (hierna: Bkl) en de Omgevingsregeling
d: implementation of directive via Besluit kwaliteit leefomgeving

parties: Asks how the technical amendment provides the legal basis for the stricter reduction obligations and how the routekaart will be defined in the Bkl rather than the law.
Why was it chosen to elaborate the specific aspects of the routekaart only in the Besluit kwaliteit leefomgeving (Bkl) and not to include frameworks for it in the law itself?
Waarom is ervoor gekozen om de specifieke aspecten van de routekaart pas in het Besluit kwaliteit leefomgeving (Bkl) uit te werken en niet reeds kaders hiervoor in de wet op te nemen?
Sees no reason to ask further questions.
The members of the VVD faction have taken note of the present document and see no reason to ask further questions.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het voorliggende stuk en zien geen aanleiding tot het stellen van nadere vragen.

Criticises the government for implementing only the EU minimum, lacking ambitious limit values, ultrafine particle norms and short-term peak standards, and asks for easier addition of substances and concentration norms.

The aim of regulating as little as possible beyond what Europe prescribes, rather than seizing the chance to regulate what the Netherlands needs, makes this amended scheme barely more valuable than what we had.

Het streven om vooral niet meer te regelen dan wat Europa ons voorschrijft, in plaats van deze kans te grijpen om te regelen en reguleren wat nodig is voor Nederland, maakt dat ook deze aangepaste regeling amper meer waard is dan wat we hadden.
Asks how the Tweede Kamer will be involved in the substantive lower-level rules (AMvB, Bkl, Or) and how consultation is organised, as well as the feasibility for municipalities and provinces.
They ask how it is ensured that the Tweede Kamer is involved in good time and substantively in this elaboration.
Zij vragen hoe wordt geborgd dat de Tweede Kamer tijdig en inhoudelijk wordt betrokken bij deze uitwerking.

Asks whether citizens and organisations get effective legal protection when limits are structurally exceeded, and whether they can directly invoke the directive's norms; also asks for stronger measures beyond WHO-linked targets.
Does the proposed amendment explicitly guarantee that citizens can directly invoke the norms from the directive?
Wordt met de voorgestelde wijzigingen expliciet geborgd dat burgers zich rechtstreeks kunnen beroepen op de normen uit de richtlijn?
Has no questions on the bill.
The members of the ChristenUnie faction have taken note of the bill with interest and have no questions.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie hebben met interesse kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben geen vragen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued an opinion on a bill amending the Omgevingswet and Awb to implement the revised EU air quality directive, finding no remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Staatssecretaris's reply (nader rapport) reports only minor changes to the explanatory memorandum, including sanctions information and an expanded transposition table.

36897.s: The bill implements EU Regulation 2024/1787 on methane emissions in the energy sector by amending the Mining Act, Energy Act, Environment Act, Environmental Management Act, Economic Offences Act and General Administrative Law Act. It designates competent authorities and inspectors and grants them administrative fines, orders under administrative enforcement, sanctions and measures, with the minister or agencies such as SodM and the emissions authority taking on these roles.
36897.j: The memorandum justifies the designation of competent authorities and sanction powers by the regulation's direct-effect obligations and the need for effective enforcement, with some safeguards such as energy supply security and General Administrative Law Act procedures.
q: The regulation has direct effect. Many of its provisions contain directly applicable obligations for operators, undertakings, producers and importers on the one hand and supervisory bodies on the other.
Veel bepalingen van de verordening bevatten rechtstreeks werkende verplichtingen voor exploitanten, ondernemingen, producenten en importeurs enerzijds en toezichthoudende instanties anderzijds.
d: designation of regulation provisions subject to inspection under the methane regulation
designation of methane regulation provisions for gas systems
further rules on the provision of information under the methane regulation
administrative fines for breaches of rules implementing the methane regulation
p: The mining inspector-general gains power to impose orders under administrative enforcement, administrative fines, sanctions and measures, with a temporary suspension pending an interim injunction request.
The emissions authority board may impose administrative fines, sanctions and measures on importers and producers, with fine ceilings tied to category amounts or turnover.
The Minister may impose sanctions and measures on gas system operators for breaches of designated regulation provisions.

parties: Asks how the government will explain how the bill relates to national methane policy, how importers can verify third-country data, and how the regulation avoids fossil lock-in, wanting effectiveness and verifiability.
The D66 members ask the government to explain how feasible the requirements are for fossil energy importers, given their dependence on data and certification from third countries.
Deze leden verzoeken de regering voorts toe te lichten hoe uitvoerbaar de eisen zijn voor importeurs van fossiele energie, gezien de afhankelijkheid van data en certificering uit derde landen.

Worries about supply security and rising costs from the regulation, and asks whether the government will redo the impact assessment and address the emissions authority's criticisms about interpretation and small importers.
Does the government agree with these members that in the current turbulent times additional standards and obligations could lead to supply security problems in the future?
Is de regering het met deze leden eens dat in de huidige onrustig tijd extra standaarden en verplichtingen kunnen leiden tot leveringszekerheidsproblemen in de toekomst?
Demands that the penalty clause not be postponed and that the implementing act proceed on schedule, rejecting arguments from the fossil lobby.
Will the government guarantee that no postponement of the penalty clause will be granted?
Zal de regering garanderen dat er géén uitstel van de boeteclausule wordt verleend?
Opposes EU climate measures as raising energy prices and threatening strategic industry and supply security, and asks whether the government will reject these EU rules.
They ask whether the government is willing to send these EU rules to the trash bin.
Zij vragen of de regering bereid is deze EU-regels naar de prullenbak te verwijzen.
Asks how the authorities will set methane intensity values and enforce safeguards for energy supply security, and how the government will ensure supply and affordability.
These members explicitly ask the government how it will, both nationally and at European level, prevent natural gas supply security and affordability from being endangered.
Deze leden vragen de regering nadrukkelijk hoe zij – zowel in nationaal als in Europees verband – zal voorkomen dat de leveringszekerheid en betaalbaarheid van aardgas in gevaar komen.

Asks for clarity on the division of powers between the minister and SodM, enforcement through ministerial regulations not yet available to parliament, a full regulatory burden calculation, and periodic information to parliament.
Does the government consider it careful that the House is now handling a law whose actual operation on key points cannot yet be tested?
Acht de regering het zorgvuldig dat de Kamer nu een wet behandelt waarvan de feitelijke werking op kernpunten nog niet toetsbaar is?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the Uitvoeringswet methaanverordening, raising concerns about the new administrative power to seize profits from non-compliance, its classification as a sanction, its interference with property rights, and the limited criminalisation of four obligations for only some operators. The government's nader rapport reports that most points were followed, adding procedural safeguards, a two-tier appeal, an explanation on property rights and calculation of economic gain, and expanded motivation for the WED choices.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanation to clarify how the administrative seizure order is to be classified and which procedural guarantees apply, given ECHR Article 6; the government added safeguards and a two-tier appeal.

The Afdeling asked the government to justify the interference with property rights under EU Charter Article 17 and ECHR Protocol 1 Article 1 against the requirements of law, legitimate aim and proportionality.
The Afdeling asked for clarity on what counts as profits or avoided losses and how such economic advantage is calculated, given foreseeability requirements.

The Afdeling found insufficient justification for criminalising four obligations only for mining-regulated operators and not for energy-regulated operators, and asked for better motivation or amendment.
